question: Which learned methods are used for cardinality estimation in database query optimizers?

answer_txt.title: Learned estimators
answer_txt.tldr: Two families of learned estimators exist.
answer_txt.text:
- Query-driven estimators featurize predicates (1, Kipf et al., 2019).

- Data-driven estimators model the joint distribution of the attribute values with deep autoregressive networks (2, Yang et al., 2020). They outperform histograms (3, Leis et al., 2015).

snippets: Query-driven estimators learn a regression from featurized predicates to observed cardinalities on past workloads. Training uses past queries.
